WITH fielding_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.player_id, p.bats
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
),
hand_counts AS (
  SELECT bats, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM fielding_players
  GROUP BY bats
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(h.bats, 'NULL') as bats,
  h.count,
  CAST(h.count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share,
  h.count - t.avg_count as above_average
FROM hand_counts h
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE h.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY h.bats
